Name: Dishon, Son of Anah
Summary: Dishon was a son of Anah and a grandson of Zibeon, and the father of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
KeyStory: Dishon is named among Anah's children, a different Dishon from the son of Seir.
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name and walk very different paths; God knows each one.
